primary_result: CONVIR_ONLY_RDPCM_V1 passed the frozen protected-data-free S0 architecture qualification after the approved 256x256 production-path fixture repair: exact official-checkpoint reuse, strict identity no-op, controlled gradient reachability, finite outputs, trainable scope, parameter limit, and memory-increment limit all passed with zero optimizer steps.
gate_reasons: All 602 official checkpoint keys loaded, with exactly the 9 declared RDPCM keys absent from the official checkpoint and no unexpected or shape-mismatched keys.
Initial, disabled, and restored RDPCM states were bitwise identical to the official ConvIR-B outputs at all three scales with atol=0 and rtol=0.

The exact-no-op initialization delivered a finite nonzero gradient to RDPCM.output_gate; controlled activation delivered finite nonzero gradients to shared, demand, protection, residual, and output_gate groups.
The frozen RDPCM trainable scope contained 41699 parameters, below the 50000 limit.
Peak allocated-memory increment was 424686592 bytes, below the 536870912-byte limit.
No optimizer step, training, scientific data, confirmation, canary, or locked-test access occurred.
competing_explanation: The result rules out the preregistered explanation that an apparent no-op merely hides broken checkpoint reuse or disconnected upstream gradients, but it does not rule out failure to learn useful spatial modulation or failure to improve restoration quality.
limitations: This is one deterministic synthetic CUDA engineering qualification, not a restoration-effect experiment.

The approved fixture repair changed only the protected-data-free production-path fixture from 64x64 to the smallest standard 256x256 geometry that satisfies the official ConvIR reflection-padding constraints.

PASS authorizes only one small Haze4K development mechanism-discrimination contract; it does not authorize training now, confirmation, NH-HAZE, locked-test use, promotion, deployment, or an effectiveness claim.
